features: Keyvo KW4: MINI Bluetooth Keyboard & Mouse combo kit is compatible with Tablets, Smartphones, Notebooks, & Desktops. The design is Ultra-Slim, and the keyboard has 78 Keys and a Rechargeable battery.
Advanced Bluetooth tech ensures a Strong, Stable Connection for the Keyboard & Mouse with up to 10m range. Easy to pair & use, the keyboard also includes Multimedia & Hot keys for Quick Access.
Bluetooth Keyboard is Compact, Slim, Lightweight, Travel-friendly & Easy to Store || It includes 11 Multimedia Hot Keys for Your Convenience || Just 2hrs Quick Charge via Type-C Port (DC5V/1A max.)
The Bluetooth Mouse with 1600 DPI Optical Sensor offers Accurate Tracking. Features 3 buttons, scroll wheel & 3 DPI levels (1000/1200/1600). Easy Plug-and-Play setup—just connect and start using.
6-month manufacturer's warranty on manufacturing defects | AAA batteries for the Wireless Mouse are Not included in the package.
